title: Pocketwire Rewards Programme Terms: One Membership per Customer
content:
A customer may hold one Pocketwire Rewards membership, and no more than 1 membership that is not closed can exist for the same customer at any time.

## Clause

1. A membership is opened only if the customer holds no other membership whose status is anything other than closed.
2. A customer whose membership was closed may re-enrol. The new membership starts again at Pocketwire Rewards Member with a zero balance.
3. Forfeited points are never restored, including on re-enrolment.

## Basis of the check

The check rests on the system record of the customer's memberships, read before the new membership is opened: every membership held under the same customer reference number, and the status each one carries. What the customer says about an earlier membership does not replace that record.

## Status of an existing membership and its effect on a new one

| Status of the customer's other membership | A new membership can be opened |
|---|---|
| enrolled | No |
| active | No |
| suspended | No |
| closed | Yes, starting at Pocketwire Rewards Member with a zero balance |

The table follows from clause 1: every status other than closed stands in the way; closed alone does not.

## Hypothetical cases

- A customer left the programme last year and the old membership shows closed. A new membership may be opened; it starts at Member with a zero balance, and the points forfeited at the old closure stay forfeited.
- A customer's membership shows suspended. While it carries that status no second membership can be opened for the same customer.
